title: Do Goldfish Really Have a 3-Second Memory?
summary: Everyone has heard that goldfish forget everything in three seconds. Here is what experiments with real goldfish show.

beats.text: Everyone says a goldfish forgets everything in three seconds. Is that true?
Myth or fact? Make your guess.
beats.reveal: Myth! Goldfish can remember things for months, not seconds.

beats.text: The myth says three seconds. Real experiments show goldfish can remember for months.
So where did the myth come from? Nobody knows for sure. Maybe a fish circling a small bowl just looks forgetful.
Scientists played a sound every time they fed the fish. Soon the fish swam over at the sound alone, even with no food.
Goldfish can even learn to push a little lever to get food.
Bonus fact: goldfish see colors, and even ultraviolet light, which our eyes cannot see at all.

visual.text: Goldfish can see ultraviolet light, which human eyes can't.
